races.title: All Weather Championship Is Back Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict: BOOK OF LIFE is much more reliable than most at this level and if they go hard, these could be the ideal circumstances for him to end a losing run having looked unlucky a few times lately. Wrist Art often goes well in this type of event and King David is very well treated now so needs respecting. BOOK OF LIFE WRIST ART (IRE) KING DAVID (IRE)

races.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: OLIAKU has gone off at short odds both starts to date and was clearly thought a bit better than this grade so she's worth chancing to strip a lot fitter for recent comeback in a race where others have plenty to prove, too. Frantic has the form to win here but lacked gears over this trip last time and needs to prove herself quick enough. OLIAKU FRANTIC BUTTERFLY BEACH (IRE)

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: LADY PHILLIPS wasn't able to build on her debut promise when runner-up at Bath late last month, though softer ground may have been against her so she remains with potential now switched to all-weather. The daughter of Night of Thunder is the pick ahead of Noble Light , who can step forward from her first run, while Rose Deer is a newcomer to note. LADY PHILLIPS NOBLE LIGHT ROSE DEER (IRE)

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: This can go the way of the choicely-bred ZHURI , who is taken to build on the promise of her debut at the second attempt given a longer break ahead of this race. The biggest threat could come from the only newcomer in the line-up, El Kahlaa catching the eye on paper, with Fifth Amendment completing the shortlist. ZHURI EL KAHLAA FIFTH AMENDMENT (IRE)

races.title: All Weather Championship Handicap
races.verdict: SECRET SANTA hasn't stood much racing to date but the form of his winning reappearance back in May makes him very hard to overlook in this race so he's taken to cope with the step up in trip and absence. Asuka is fit and firing so looks sure to give his running and be bang there, while Rogue Messiah is well worth this try in headgear and needs keeping an eye on. SECRET SANTA (IRE) ASUKA ROGUE MESSIAH (IRE)

races.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
races.verdict: OUR PLANET has found things tough so far this season, but he shaped better than the result at this course on his latest outing and could well revive for a switch of stables. From his much reduced mark, he gets the vote ahead of Barry The Worm who isn't taken lightly at this venue, with Love Alive also considered. OUR PLANET (IRE) BARRY THE WORM LOVE ALIVE
